_contract: What the Phase-C2 BEHAVIOURAL SELECTION requires the pod's frozen assets to BE, checked by scripts/autoinit/verify_frozen_assets.py --expect before any arm is built. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
_why_this_exists: This session declares ASSETS_READY, and a session that declares it must name its own expectation -- explicit or refused, never inherited. Search-1's document names state_eval_v1, the metric suite its beam ranks on; this session ranks on a behavioural battery and never reads that suite. The replay's names only the two calibration mixtures and no battery, because it evaluates nothing. Pointing at either would demand or omit the wrong artifacts, which is a $0.05 abort with the names changed.
_what_this_session_consumes: the two calibration mixtures every arm's construction steps name -- calib.domain_balanced@v1 and calib.reasoning_heavy@v2 -- because an operator resolves its profile from disk: a drifted mixture would change every statistic without changing any recorded identity, and every arm's artifact digest would then fail its gate. The two BATTERIES are checked by their own validators at scoring time (experiments.phase_c2.scoring for screening, experiments.phase_c1.scoring for confirmation), each against its own identity record, which is a stronger check than a content hash listed here and has exactly one owner.
_identities_are_derived_not_transcribed: the two mixture identities are the same objects the replay verified on a pod that then reproduced five checkpoints byte-for-byte. They are carried across from that document rather than re-derived by hand, so there is one recorded answer for what these mixtures are.
